📅 本週 AI 新聞回顧 · 2026-08-03 ～ 2026-08-08
1. OpenAI pauses Astra model development over critical cybersecurity capabilities資安
OpenAI因資安風險暫緩Astra模型開發
OpenAI says its in-development Astra model has reached a "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and launch cyberattacks against well-protected systems. The company has paused internal work on the model while it strengthens safeguards.
OpenAI表示尚在開發中的Astra模型已達到「關鍵資安門檻」，意味著它能自主辨識並發動針對高度防護系統的網路攻擊。該公司已暫緩內部開發工作，同時強化安全防護機制。
OpenAI · 原文連結
2. NPM package keyv hit by ChainDrop supply chain attack tied to Shai-Hulud campaign資安
NPM套件Keyv供應鏈攻擊活動ChainDrop傳出源自於Shai-Hulud
The npm package keyv was compromised on August 4, infecting 444 packages within four hours and publishing 2,212 malicious versions. Multiple security firms say the ChainDrop worm used in the attack confirms it's part of the large-scale Shai-Hulud supply chain campaign.
NPM套件keyv於8月4日遭入侵，4小時內有444個套件被污染、攻擊者上架2,212個惡意版本，多家資安公司指出，這次使用的蠕蟲程式ChainDrop，證明這起事故是大規模供應鏈攻擊Shai-Hulud的一部分。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Gitea patches critical CVSS 9.8 flaw allowing unauthenticated remote code execution資安
Gitea修補CVSS 9.8重大漏洞，攻擊者無須登入即可遠端執行程式碼
Gitea disclosed CVE-2026-59774, a critical flaw letting remote attackers read server files and steal internal access tokens without logging in, as long as a publicly accessible repository exists—potentially leading to remote code execution. The CVSS 9.8 issue is fixed in Gitea 1.27.1.
開源Git服務平臺Gitea揭露重大漏洞CVE-2026-59774，遠端攻擊者不需登入，只要伺服器上有公開儲存庫，就可能讀取內部檔案並取得存取權杖，甚至執行程式碼。官方已在Gitea 1.27.1修補這項CVSS 9.8分的漏洞。
iThome · 原文連結
4. ByteDance trains massive 10-trillion-parameter AI model to rival Anthropic模型
字節跳動訓練10兆參數AI模型，力拚對抗Anthropic
TikTok owner ByteDance is training a new AI model with 10 trillion parameters as it seeks to compete more directly with Anthropic in the large language model race.
TikTok母公司字節跳動正在訓練一個擁有10兆參數的龐大AI模型，試圖在大型語言模型競賽中更直接地與Anthropic抗衡。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
5. Judge rules Meta caused "public nuisance," orders $567M for youth mental health fund政策
法官裁定Meta構成「公共妨害」，須出資5.67億美元治療青少年心理健康問題
A New Mexico judge ruled that Meta's platforms caused a "public nuisance" and ordered the company to fund a $567 million program to address the youth mental health crisis it helped create.
美國新墨西哥州法官裁定，Meta的平臺造成「公共妨害」，須出資5.67億美元成立基金，協助處理其平臺助長的青少年心理健康危機。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
6. Security researchers find Claude's shared conversations can be indexed by Google Search資安
資安業者揭露Claude分享對話可被Google搜尋，恐導致用戶敏感資訊意外曝光
Security firm Malwarebytes found that shared conversations from Anthropic's Claude chatbot can be indexed and found via Google Search, risking exposure of users' sensitive information. The issue was first spotted by Reddit users searching with specific terms.
資安業者Malwarebytes指出，Anthropic AI聊天工具Claude的分享對話可能被Google搜尋引擎索引，導致用戶對話中的敏感資訊意外曝光。這項問題最初由部分Reddit用戶透過特定搜尋方式發現。
iThome · 原文連結
7. SpaceX to invest $16.8B in Texas AI chip plant "Terafab"產業
SpaceX斥資168億美元在德州興建AI晶片廠Terafab
Texas Governor Greg Abbott announced SpaceX will build a vertically integrated AI chip plant called Terafab in Grimes County, with over $16.8 billion in first-phase investment expected to create 3,000 jobs.
德州州長Greg Abbott宣布，SpaceX將在德州格萊姆斯郡興建垂直整合式AI晶片廠Terafab，第一階段投資超過168億美元，預計創造3,000個工作機會。
iThome · 原文連結
8. AMD to acquire Canadian AI chip startup Taalas產業
AMD宣布併購加拿大AI晶片新創Taalas
AMD announced Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Canadian AI chip startup Taalas to strengthen its AI inference technology and product lineup. Financial terms were not disclosed, and the deal still requires regulatory approval.
AMD周四宣布已簽署最終協議，將收購加拿大AI晶片新創Taalas，以強化AI推論技術及產品布局。雙方未公布交易金額，收購案仍須取得監管機關批准。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Suno unveils plan to combat spammy AI-generated music with watermarks產品
Suno公布方案對抗氾濫的AI垃圾音樂，將加入水印機制
Suno announced plans to implement new watermarking technology and download limits to curb the spread of spammy AI-generated tracks and increase transparency. CEO Mikey Shulman laid out the company's principles and next steps as it seeks legitimacy.
Suno宣布將導入新的水印技術與下載限制，以遏止氾濫的AI垃圾音樂並提升透明度。執行長Mikey Shulman在部落格文章中說明公司原則及後續步驟，盼藉此爭取產業正當性。
The Verge · 原文連結
10. Google open-sources WeatherNext, cutting cyclone forecast lead time by a day研究
Google開源WeatherNext天氣模型，熱帶氣旋預報平均提前一天
Google DeepMind open-sourced WeatherNext 2 and WeatherNext Cyclones, releasing both code and model weights. A study published in Nature shows WeatherNext Cyclones can predict a storm's path, intensity, and wind field more than 24 hours earlier than leading forecast models at the same accuracy.
Google DeepMind開源WeatherNext 2與WeatherNext Cyclones天氣AI模型，公開程式碼與模型權重。同步刊登於《Nature》的研究顯示，該模型預測熱帶氣旋路徑、強度及風圈範圍時，在相同準確度下平均可比現行主要氣象模型多取得超過24小時的預報時間。
